messages:
lina_cs: :warning: Heads up — ACME support ticket: after today's canary they started getting parse errors. Their ingest expects snake_case keys (order_items) but the model response now has camelCase (orderItems) and their parser fails with KeyError. Sample request/response below.

rahul_support: Can you paste the exact response body and the request you sent? Also which model/version did the canary flip to?

lina_cs: Request we sent: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1-instruct","prompt":"extract order info","response_format":{"type":"json_schema","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object"}}}}}}'```

Actual response (returned by API): ```{"orderId":"12345","orderItems":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],"total":49.99}```

Expected (previous behavior): ```{"order_id":12345,"order_items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],"total":49.99}```

maya_eng: Thanks. Which rollout/variant specifically? Any change to the response postprocessing or a new runtime patch this morning?

lina_cs: Model ID in request was `redwood-2.1-instruct` and we were routed to variant `v2-b`. Deploy bot shows a canary flip at ~1991112200. Customer asserts this started exactly after that. No changes on their side.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete: redwood-2.1-instruct v2-b at 1991112200.

maya_eng: I'll try to reproduce against the same variant. Quick Q: did you set any casing flags in the response_format or postprocessing? previous runtime behavior always preserved user-provided schema key casing (snake_case).

lina_cs: We did not set any casing flags. Customer used our JSON Schema output path only. Parser error from customer: `KeyError: 'order_items'` when they do `resp['order_items']`. They pasted the response above.

maya_eng: Reproduced locally against v2-b. Minimal repro prompt -> observed camelCase behavior. Initial investigation: postprocessing library (postproc v0.7.3) introduced a normalization step that converts keys to camelCase by default when the model returns a multi-word key. This was not present in 0.7.2. Looks like runtime pulled new postproc via the canary.

maya_eng: Action plan: 1) rollback postproc to 0.7.2 on v2-b canary by 1991112355 if no objections, 2) patch postproc to respect `preserve_case` flag and add an opt-out for customers expecting snake_case, 3) add regression test for schema key casing. I'll open the PR and run canary validations. :eyes:

todd_prod: Marking P2. If rollback is fast, do it. Notify affected customers and offer temporary transform: we can map camelCase->snake_case at the ingress for their workspace until fully fixed.

lina_cs: Thanks — please confirm ETA and I'll message ACME with workaround (we can offer a simple transform or immediate rollback). Keep me posted. :thumbsup:

maya_eng: ETA for rollback: 30m. ETA for fix + deploy: next patch cycle (4-6 hrs to validate). I'll post updates here.
